name: XBYT
title: A trusted marketplace for devices
description: A marketplace in Ghana for verified smartphones and laptops, with warranty on every purchase and iPhone trade-in.
summary: Verified smartphones and laptops, backed by warranty.
overview: XBYT is an online marketplace in Ghana for smartphones and laptops. Every device is checked, graded by condition and backed by a warranty.

Buyers can shop new, refurbished and pre-owned devices, trade in an iPhone toward an upgrade, and confirm orders on WhatsApp with delivery to their door. Trusted suppliers can apply to sell on the platform.

scope.name: Verified devices
scope.text: IMEI-verified, diagnostically tested and graded by condition.

scope.name: Warranty
scope.text: Every purchase includes a warranty and after-sales support.

scope.name: iPhone trade-in
scope.text: Trade in an old iPhone toward an upgrade.

scope.name: Sell on XBYT
scope.text: A seller programme for trusted suppliers.

ownership: A client project. XBYT belongs to its owners.
